name: Jacob Helberg
current_role: U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs (since October 16, 2025)
summary: Jacob Helberg is the State Department’s Under Secretary for Economic Affairs, where he launched Pax Silica, a U.S.-led pact on AI and critical-mineral supply chains. Before that he led Google’s global policy work against foreign interference, served on the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission (2022–2024), advised Palantir CEO Alex Karp, wrote The Wires of War (2021) and co-founded the Hill & Valley Forum. A Democratic donor in 2020, he gave $1 million to back Trump in 2024; he is married to investor Keith Rabois.
